title: session-load counts file reads per process class from an fs_usage capture the operator makes
goal: python3 _tools/benchmarks.py run session-load --fs-usage FILE reads a capture of fs_usage -w -f filesys, starts no replay and no model, and writes per process class (by the process name each line ends with: python3 kb-tools, git, lsof, claude, fseventsd, else other) and for all a file_reads row (open for reading, read, pread and RdData lines; writes left out) and a distinct_paths row, case 'capture <class>'; without --fs-usage the scenario prints the sudo fs_usage command the operator runs by hand beside it, and no check or run of the tool calls sudo

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import csv, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
cap = os.path.join(T, 'fs_usage.txt')
L = [
    '13:21:46.312411  open              F=3        (R_____N____)  /work/kb/_tools/kbcommon.py                 0.000030   python3.4101',
    '13:21:46.312499  read              F=3    B=0x1a2b                                                       0.000011   python3.4101',
    '13:21:46.313000  open              F=4        (R_____N____)  /work/kb/_tools/coord.py                    0.000021   python3.4101',
    '13:21:46.313100  write             F=4    B=0x10                                                         0.000009   python3.4101',
    '13:21:46.313200  open              F=5        (_WC____N___)  /work/kb/_cache/out.json                    0.000040   python3.4101',
    '13:21:46.314000  RdData[A]         D=0x0012a3b0  B=0x1000   /dev/disk3s1  /work/kb/.git/index         0.000150 W git.4202',
    '13:21:46.314100  pread             F=6    B=0x200   O=0x00000000                                         0.000008   git.4202',
    '13:21:46.315000  open              F=7        (R__________)  /work/kb                                    0.000012   lsof.4303',
    '13:21:46.316000  open              F=8        (R__________)  /Library/Preferences/x.plist                0.000012   mds.4404',
    '13:21:46.316100  WrData[A]         D=0x0012a3c0  B=0x1000   /dev/disk3s1  /work/kb/.git/index.lock    0.000150 W git.4202',
]
open(cap, 'w').write('\n'.join(L) + '\n')
out = os.path.join(T, 'out.csv')
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'run', 'session-load', '--fs-usage', cap, '--out', out],
                   capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(out, encoding='utf-8'))) if os.path.exists(out) else []
shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
assert p.returncode == 0, ('run session-load --fs-usage exit', p.returncode, p.stderr[-400:])
val = {(r['case'], r['metric']): float(r['value']) for r in rows if r['scenario'] == 'session-load'}
want = {('capture kb-tools', 'file_reads'): 3, ('capture kb-tools', 'distinct_paths'): 2,
        ('capture git', 'file_reads'): 2, ('capture lsof', 'file_reads'): 1, ('capture other', 'file_reads'): 1,
        ('capture all', 'file_reads'): 7}
for k, v in want.items():
    assert val.get(k) == v, ('wrong or missing', k, val.get(k), 'want', v)
assert not [r for r in rows if r['metric'] in ('cpu_s', 'spend_usd')], '--fs-usage ran a replay or a model'
